boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Scranton, Shared as Cards
boards.description: An under-21-safe sequence mixing campus orientation, low-key spaces, recreation, downtown exploration, and a university-sponsored weekend activity.

cards.entity_name: John and Jacquelyn Dionne Campus Green
cards.title: Start with a campus landmark
cards.subtitle: A map-listed green at University of Scranton
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate Dionne Green, then walk its edges to connect nearby buildings before making plans elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: Begin by getting your bearings on a named campus green.
cards.evidence_claim: The University's campus map lists Dionne Green as a campus structure.
cards.access_notes: Use the current campus map and follow any posted access guidance.

cards.title: Make a first meal plan
cards.subtitle: Fresh Food Company and Food Court locations
cards.notes: Check the dining options in the DeNaples Center and choose a meal stop that fits your dining plan or payment method.
cards.short_summary: Use the main dining hub to settle in and refuel.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025-2026 Student Handbook lists Fresh Food Company on the third floor and the DeNaples Food Court on the first floor.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires an applicable meal plan, Flex dollars, guest meal, or other accepted payment.

cards.title: See what is showing
cards.subtitle: Hyland Hall, fourth floor
cards.notes: Look at the current exhibition schedule, then set aside a quiet afternoon visit to the gallery on the fourth floor of Hyland Hall.
cards.short_summary: A current-exhibition stop with documented public free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: University information states that Hope Horn Gallery exhibits are open to the public free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are listed as Sunday-Friday noon-4 p.m. and Wednesday 6-8 p.m.; confirm the exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Harry and Jeanette Weinberg Memorial Library
cards.title: Choose a reset spot
cards.subtitle: 300 Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Take a short orientation lap through the library, then use its study areas or ask the Library Services Desk for help finding resources.
cards.short_summary: A five-floor library stop for study space and practical help.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers study spaces and states that its Pro Deo Room, Reilly Learning Commons, and second and third floors are accessible to students 24 hours a day when campus is open.
cards.source_title: Welcome New and Returning Students! Library Updates for Spring 2026
cards.access_notes: Students need a Royal Card for after-hours access; the stated 24-hour spaces are available when campus is open.

cards.title: Take an outdoor breather
cards.subtitle: Patio adjacent to Weinberg Memorial Library
cards.notes: Step outside beside the library for a brief break, then return to campus plans with the nearby map and building names in mind.
cards.short_summary: A named landscaped patio beside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The University describes Galvin Terrace as a landscaped outdoor patio adjacent to Weinberg Memorial Library.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor availability can vary with weather and campus operations.

cards.title: Pause for quiet reflection
cards.subtitle: Former Scranton Estate building
cards.notes: If a calm stop suits your weekend, visit the Chapel of the Sacred Heart respectfully and check Campus Ministry for current service details.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel identified for reflection and daily Mass.
cards.evidence_claim: The University describes the Chapel of the Sacred Heart as a place for quiet reflection and daily Mass.
cards.access_notes: Roman Catholic services are available on campus during the week; check Campus Ministry for current times and locations.

cards.title: Move between plans
cards.subtitle: Recreational Sports facility
cards.notes: Bring your Royal Card and appropriate attire, then check with Recreational Sports about using the courts, pool, track, or equipment.
cards.short_summary: A student-access recreation stop with multiple indoor activity areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Byron Recreation Complex has courts, a track, pool, racquetball/handball courts, cycling room, and ping pong tables; Royal Cards are required for recreation facilities.
cards.access_notes: Royal Cards are required; confirm activity availability and facility hours with Recreational Sports.

cards.title: Watch the campus fields
cards.subtitle: University outdoor athletics facility
cards.notes: Walk by Fitzpatrick Field during a campus loop and consult the athletics schedule if you want to plan around a posted game or event.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor field used for varsity and recreation activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies Fitzpatrick Field as its main outdoor athletic facility and home to soccer, field hockey, and lacrosse.
cards.access_notes: Event access and schedules vary; use the official athletics schedule for a specific game.

cards.title: Explore Scranton rail history
cards.subtitle: 150 South Washington Avenue, Scranton
cards.notes: Head downtown for the visitor center, museum, and grounds; skip paid train rides unless you specifically want to purchase a ticket.
cards.short_summary: A downtown National Park Service site with free grounds and museum access.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service states that Steamtown's visitor center, museums, and grounds are free to enter with no pass required.
cards.source_title: Fees & Passes | Steamtown National Historic Site
cards.access_notes: Free entry applies to the visitor center, museums, and grounds; train rides have separate fees and availability.

cards.title: End with a campus-hosted activity
cards.subtitle: Friday or Saturday evening programming
cards.notes: Check RoyalSync or the Late Night channel for a current event, then attend the listed activity with friends and follow event guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night at Scranton offers alcohol-free social activities, including trivia, movie nights, games, cultural celebrations, and creative workshops; funding applies to Friday or Saturday events between 8 p.m. and 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The University states that funded Late Night events occur Friday or Saturday between 8:00 p.m. and 1:00 a.m.; confirm the specific event on RoyalSync.
